compiled_state.title: [sprint/merge-to-main]: Session branch not pushed to origin -> Per-Story LLM Review CI fails with 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref'
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**Observed behavior:** Per-Story LLM Review CI job fails with:
```
fatal: couldn't find remote ref worktree-20260514-232408
##[error]Process completed with exit code 128.
```

The job fetches `origin/${SPRINT_SESSION_ID}` to compute the per-story delta. When the session branch (e.g. `worktree-20260514-232408`) is never pushed to origin, the fetch fails and the review job errors.

**Expected behavior:** Per-Story LLM Review completes successfully. The session branch should be pushed to origin before or when the story branch PR is created.

**Root cause:** `merge-to-main.sh` pushes the story branch and creates the PR but does not push the session branch. In local worktree sessions the session branch is a local-only ref.

**Workaround:** Manually run `git push origin <session-branch>` before or after creating the story PR.

**Fix direction:** `merge-to-main.sh` (or the sprint Phase A draft-PR creation step) should push the session branch to origin alongside the story branch push so the Per-Story LLM Review job can always fetch it.

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 3 (INTERMEDIATE) — CI-only failure, single subsystem, deterministic
